flows:
Navigate to https://www.arthritis.org/ then Use only keyboard input.
Use Tab or Shift+Tab to move focus and Enter or Space to activate the exact control.
Move in whichever direction is shorter.
Group repeated Tab presses if supported, checking focus frequently.
Do not click, focus elements directly, use JavaScript, or navigate directly to the destination.
Keep focus on the page.
If you have checked both Tab directions and the exact control keeps getting skipped, @v16:"report the barrier and stop".
If it receives focus, @v16:"activate it immediately and check the outcome once".
The exact visible target is outside the sequential Tab order in the initial browser state.
Check this with several real focus moves, including forward Tab, then if the target remains skipped, @v16:"report the barrier and stop".
Do not search for a different control.
Stay on this public site.
Do not sign in, register, pay, or interact with a CAPTCHA or access challenge.
Leave fixture settings unchanged.
Use visible controls only.
Use Tab and Enter to reach and activate “About Arthritis”.
Verify the public destination at /about-arthritis.

verdict.root_cause: The agent treated the visible navigation link as unreachable even though the run screenshots show a focus outline on “About Arthritis.” It continued moving focus instead of pressing Enter immediately, so the required page was never opened.
verdict.agent_fault_assessment: The agent caused the outcome. It used keyboard navigation as required, but the screenshots show the exact “About Arthritis” control focused with a blue outline. The instruction required immediate activation when focus reached the target; instead, later steps continued with Tab and Shift+Tab. The reported barrier is therefore incorrect. The logged failed requests are unrelated analytics and telemetry traffic, not evidence that the public site or target link was unavailable.

verdict.suggestion: Correct the agent logic to recognize the focused target from the focus indicator and press Enter immediately. Do not report a skipped-control barrier once the target has received focus.
